message: Scaled 2 of 4 feed rates to 80 %; 2 left as written (zero or negative), 1 clamped to a limit.

findings.message: F0. is a feed of zero, which is a block that does not cut, so it is left exactly as written and the percentage is not applied. The smallest feed (700) is not applied to it either: a limit bounds a scaled feed, it does not invent one.

F-100 is negative, which is not a feed rate, so it is left exactly as written and the percentage is not applied. The smallest feed (700) is not applied to it either: a limit bounds a scaled feed, it does not invent one.
F250. would become 200.; the smallest feed (700) was used instead.
